name: Agent Usage
author: RektyRowdyy
description: The Omarchy Agents widget with a toggleable inline view: left-click to show your default agent's session and weekly usage right in the bar.

barWidget.description: Left-click toggles icon ↔ inline session · weekly usage, right-click opens the usage dashboard, middle-click launches an agent.

schema.label: Bar view
schema.description: What the bar shows. Left-click the widget to toggle.

schema.label: Inline agent
schema.description: Agent id whose usage is shown inline (claude, codex, fireworks, …).

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.
